title: cs-daily-scratchpad-maya-singh-2026-05-20
content:
Daily scratchpad - QBR prep, renewals, and support follow-ups
Date: 2026-05-20
Owner: Maya Singh
---
Today focus:
- QBR prep for NovaPay (Thu 2026-05-21 10:00 PT) — finalize slides and top 3 ask
- Renewal outreach: Zenith Analytics (renewal due 2026-06-05) — confirm decision-maker and propose skus
- Open support escalations: ticket JIRA-1278 (high latency on dedicated pool) — sync with SRE and triage notes

Top accounts to touch today:
1) NovaPay (Enterprise, ARR $420k)
   - Meeting: 2026-05-21 10:00 PT (QBR)
   - Prep: slide deck draft in /confluence/NovaPay-QBR (shared); highlight 99th pct latency improvement, cost delta after quantization pilot
   - Ask: proposal for Dedicated Premium (2-year) + advanced observability addon
   - Action: run last 90-day latency chart + top 5 error traces (ask @Jordan for traces by EOD)

2) Zenith Analytics (Mid-market, ARR $95k)
   - Renewal window opens 2026-05-25, decision expected by 2026-06-05
   - Risk: usage spike last month; possibility of moving to competitor lower-cost inference
   - Action: send tailored renewal email with 3 options (standard, discounted committed, and usage cap) — draft below

3) Aurora Health (Private deployment pilot)
   - Status: P0 compliance question on logging retention; solution: recommend encrypted audit log + KMS integration
   - Action: coordinate with Security (Aisha) to produce short FAQ by 2026-05-22

Support follow-ups / tickets:
- JIRA-1278: Dedicated pool latency regression
  - Current status: assigned to SRE (Ryan). Need triage notes + impact statement for NovaPay QBR
  - My note: ask SRE to run perf profile on quantized model variant; record expected token throughput drop
  - Slack thread: #sre-dedicated -> link pinned (ask Ryan for permalink)

- JIRA-1234: Embeddings accuracy drift (Zenith)
  - Owner: Jordan
  - Action: request sample prompts and recent outputs to reproduce locally; add to eval suite

Draft outreach email (Zenith Analytics renewal) - quick template:
Subject: Renewal options and next steps for Zenith Analytics
Hi Alex,

Quick note to share renewal options ahead of your decision window. We value the partnership and want to make the next term predictable and cost-effective. Short options below — happy to set a 30-min call.

Option A (Renew as-is): 12mo at current committed rates.
Option B (Committed + Discount): 12mo with 10% discount for a 25% spike protection band.
Option C (Usage + Cap): Pay-as-you-go with a soft monthly cap + automatic alerts and cost-control rules.

Attachments: usage summary (last 90 days), top performance wins after batching changes.

Would you be open to a quick call next week?
Best,
Maya

QBR slide checklist (NovaPay) - must have:
- Exec summary (3 bullets)
- SLA & availability review (last quarter numbers)
- Performance improvements (before/after quantization and batching) + graphs
- Cost outcomes (per-token costs, any savings observed)
- Risks & mitigation (fallback policies, region, model variants)
- Ask & next steps (procurement timeline; contract owner)

Notes to self / reminders:
- Ask Legal for updated T&Cs for Dedicated Premium (may affect renewal pricing) — ping @Legal-Amanda
- Update renewal tracker spreadsheet with Zenith decision options row (link: spreadsheet/renewal-tracker)
- Prepare 1-slide appendix on fallback routing (how we avoid outages) — tech owner: @Jordan
- Follow up with Aisha on Aurora compliance FAQ by Fri 2026-05-22

Unresolved questions / escalation points:
- NovaPay: need clarity on which business owner will sign (Procurement vs. CTO) — ask during pre-QBR call
- Zenith: confirm whether they view our unit economics vs. competitor TCO as leading or parity

Timeboxed plan for today:
- 09:00–09:30: Quick sync with Jordan to review QBR perf graphs
- 09:30–10:30: Draft QBR deck (slides 1–6)
- 11:00–11:30: Call with SRE on JIRA-1278
- 13:00–14:00: Renewal email drafts and update tracker
- 15:00–15:30: Slack follow-ups + handoff notes to Aisha

Quick links / refs:
- Confluence: /display/CS/Account+Playbook
- Renewal tracker: spreadsheet/renewal-tracker
- JIRA: JIRA-1278, JIRA-1234
- Slack channels: #cs-novapay, #sre-dedicated

Raw notes / snippets:

- For Zenith cost concern: prepare per-100k token cost table for hosted vs. dedicated vs. quantized on A100/4-bit

Done-when checklist for today:
- QBR deck first draft uploaded to Confluence + share with Jordan & Aisha
- Renewal email to Alex (Zenith) queued or scheduled
- JIRA-1278 triage notes recorded and short impact statement prepared for NovaPay

Notes to self: keep everything short and action oriented. If stuck on numbers, call @Finance Luke for quick pull of per-customer billing CSV.
